purpose: Test a played-point trust region after the logistic-GP root-cause audit

arm.name: gp-v4-local
arm.initial_design: one kernel-length in both directions on every axis
arm.exploitation: one coordinate from a previously measured configuration

selection_rule: Recommend the posterior-mean best measured configuration
notes: The local rule is used only for exploitation; explicit exploration remains global.
Training scores and posterior estimates are diagnostic, not Elo evidence.
The arm is compared on the same held-out openings as the earlier GP variants.
